name: cleanroom_seed_ensemble_v1
purpose: Measure random-init variance and test a fixed three-seed ensemble without using Enzyme-405 for selection.
ensemble: arithmetic mean of member cosine scores for every identical dev query-candidate pair
development_rule: Three-seed mean must have a higher mean joint percentile than seed20260723 on folds 0,1,2. If selected, freeze before training/evaluating folds 3/4.
confirmatory_rule: On untouched folds 3/4 compare the frozen three-seed mean against seed20260723 under the same metric panel; do not retune from confirmatory outcomes.
external_policy: Do not use Enzyme-405 to select or tune this study.
